QuestionStmt.S: A box contains 9 tickets numbered 1 to 9 both inclusive. If 3 tickets are drawn from the box one at a time, then the probability that they are alternatively either {odd, even, odd} or {even, odd, even} is

Solution.S:
Number of tickets = 9
Number of odd tickets = 5
Number of even tickets = 4

Required probability = P(odd, even, odd) + P(even, odd, even)

$$= \frac{^5C_1}{^9C_1} \times \frac{^4C_1}{^8C_1} \times \frac{^4C_1}{^7C_1} + \frac{^4C_1}{^9C_1} \times \frac{^5C_1}{^8C_1} \times \frac{^3C_1}{^7C_1}$$

$$= \frac{5}{9} \times \frac{4}{8} \times \frac{4}{7} + \frac{4}{9} \times \frac{5}{8} \times \frac{3}{7}$$
$$= \frac{80}{504} + \frac{60}{504} = \frac{140}{504} = \frac{5}{18}$$
